subject: Post-call: eval scaffold & short-run kickoff for PraxisAI
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morales <lena.morales@praxisai.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@praxisai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: eval scaffold & short-run kickoff for PraxisAI

Hi Lena / Tom — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed immediate next steps so we can start a focused model-fit short-run (500 samples) on Redwood: 

1) Recommended model candidates (based on call notes):
   - redwood-compat/llama2-13b-q4f32 (best latency/cost tradeoff for instruction tasks)
   - redwood-2.1-8b-int8 (if you prefer a smaller footprint for lower cost)
   - fallback: redwood-legacy/7b for throughput testing

2) Short-run scope we propose:
   - 500 representative prompts (we can accept your CSV or use our sample-500 template)
   - Topline metrics: exact match / task-specific F1, answer helpfulness (1-5), hallucination flag rate
   - Latency P50/P90 on your expected request size (median token length ~120)

3) Data & format: see attached praxis_eval_template.csv. Required columns: id, prompt, expected_answer_snippet, task_type, priority_tag. Optional: patient_age_group, modality_hint.

4) Scoring & regression guardrails:
   - Pass thresholds: F1 >= 0.78 for high-priority prompts; hallucination <= 6%
   - If a rollout later drops 3+ points vs baseline on high-priority set, we trigger regression alert and rollback policy

5) Compliance/ops notes:
   - For the short-run we can use Redwood hosted sandbox in us-west; logs retained 30 days by default (can extend for audit)
   - If you need customer-managed keys, we’ll switch to Private preview for the pilot (extra ops lead time ~2 weeks)

Next steps (action items):
   - Lena: confirm you can share 500-row CSV (or say if you want Redwood to sample) — target by EOD Mon (1/19)
   - Tom: procurement question (cc) on SOW rate card — we’ll loop Ben to expedite
   - Ben/Marissa: schedule 30-min kickoff to upload dataset + run sample jobs (propose Tue 1/20 10am PT)

Attachments included: praxis_eval_template.csv, scoring_rubric.pdf. I also uploaded a short scoring sheet to the Drive and a HubSpot playbook link below.

Thanks — Avery

--
Avery Johnson
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: eval scaffold & short-run kickoff for PraxisAI

Thanks Avery — very helpful. A few clarifying items before we upload: 

• Scoring rubric: the "helpfulness 1-5" — is that a single annotator score or aggregated from 3 raters? For our compliance logs we'd prefer aggregate.
• Thresholds: the 0.78 F1 pass threshold — is that strict per-sample or per-task average?
• Latency: our SLA target is P95 < 400ms for typical user queries. You mentioned P90 — do you expect to meet P95 on the 13b quantized candidate?

We can share a sanitized 500-row CSV by EOD Tue (1/20). Also attaching a small sample (sample_500_rows.csv) — it's synthetic but structured like our exports.

Lena
Lead PM, PraxisAI Health
Lena.Morales@praxisai.com

Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: eval scaffold & short-run kickoff for PraxisAI

Hi Lena — quick answers: 

• Helpfulness score: we recommend 3 annotators and report the median and inter-annotator agreement (Kripp alpha). We’ll include both aggregate and per-annotator breakdown in the scoring output.
• F1 threshold is a per-task average across the high-priority subset (not per-sample). We’ll flag any single sample with catastrophic failure (e.g., safety/hallucination) separately.
• Latency P95: for redwood-compat/llama2-13b-q4f32 we expect P95 around 350–420ms depending on concurrent load and prompt length — on a reserved Dedicated pool we can consistently get under 400ms. For the hosted sandbox we’ll likely see more variability.

Action: I’ll drop a HubSpot note (hs_987654321) and a one-page SOW for quick procurement signoff. If procurement needs immediate numbers we can provide an interim SOW (no commitment) to enable the trial.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
